Every read/resource/allocation failure poisons cursor against resume; torn-tail success only at actual EOF with explicit permission. Complete-byte offset includes raw terminators. This is framing, not JSON/crypto/source-identity validation or whole-history memory limit. Four authored fragmentation/oversize/readerfailure/offsetoverflow tests source-read only; no native fixture or executed result.
